purpose: Make a decision before next gameweek using additional historical chronological validation; the prospective GW8-12 study is monitoring, not an adoption gate.
split: For each year S, train and calibrate exclusively on seasons <S and score every defender appearance in S. Player-history features may update using preceding appearances, as in the existing production evaluation. Fit once per season, not weekly.
configurations: The exact existing locked legacy GBM and monotonic HGB parameters. No new candidate, search, calibration choice or threshold tuning on these outcomes.
calibration: Existing five-fold shuffled stratified OOF isotonic calibration, using only training seasons. Inherits temporal/player dependence limitations within the training OOF folds.
data: Unchanged §41 defender_frame.pkl; verify the original live-input fingerprints. No new data sources or production changes during testing.
decision_now: Retain the update unless the additional pooled LL OR Brier worsens by >0.002 and the corresponding paired player-cluster 95% interval lies entirely above zero, or a monotonicity invariant fails. Such evidence triggers a review of rollback rather than further parameter selection. Otherwise make an explicit keep-update decision now, acknowledging uncertainty and the 2025 calibration tradeoff. Report individual-season failures, even if pooled results pass.
retrospective_limitations: These seasons are excluded from each fit, but not pristine independent test data: the legacy parameters and pipeline were developed using historical data
2022-24 use the fbref era; 2025-26 existing tests are more relevant to the current FPL source
Existing detailed position features use realized row positions; this is a shared retrospective train/serve limitation, not proof of fully pre-match performance
This test does not measure weekly refit instability
No claim of future accuracy certainty can be made before future results
future_check: Preserve the immutable GW8-12 snapshots and original assessment protocol. Their completion is not required for the present production decision.
